purpose: Review-only final small-artifact candidate inventory; not the approved curation manifest.
included_content_policy: Small reports, CSV/JSON scientific summaries and validations, per-case diagnostic figures, geometry metadata, profile/actual/grid CSVs, and small CUDA/runtime/source proof files.
Bounded surfaces/minibatch-losses.npz only when less than 1 MiB; it is a seven-by-128 scalar cross-entropy matrix, not a tensor checkpoint.
excluded_content_policy: Geometry/random/reference/attack basis arrays (.npy), including symlink targets.
Corpora, prepared/raw benchmark examples, observed-batches.jsonl, tokenizer data, caches, evaluation result directories, and W&B logs.
Every directory symlink is recorded only as a link target and is never recursively traversed.
Any selected file larger than 5 MiB is omitted and recorded under oversize_not_added.
